claim: Remote touch technology begins to emerge
originalWording: Remote touch technology begins to emerge

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: P02 Personal relationships in 2009, first clause of haptics/chat bullet

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Networked haptics let people touch or manipulate distant objects/other users in limited practical demonstrations.
reference.rationale: The scholarly account of the 2002 Boston–London virtual handshake establishes the emerging capability well before 2009. Further haptics progress preserves this modest success. The stronger full-body tactile claim is separately scored K031.
